title: La correspondance du chancelier Antoine Du Bourg (1535-1538), École des chartes (ELEC)
institution: École nationale des chartes (Éditions en ligne de l'École des chartes, ELEC)
notes: Letters of Francis I and others to Antoine Du Bourg, chancellor of France, with a short inquiry on the Great Bible of 1536-1537. Each text is readable online without login and the complete TEI XML source is served at the data link. Counts are our own, from that TEI file: 96 separate texts (95 letters plus the Great Bible inquiry), about 34,000 words of text, excluding the editors' notes. All dated 1536-1538. The TEI history ends in March 2012 and the server files date from July 2012; no later change found, so the edition is marked archived.
